  About the company:   

 Our client is a growing Allied Health provider committed to delivering holistic, client-centred care to individuals across various age groups and support needs. Their multidisciplinary team works collaboratively to empower clients to build independence, confidence, and meaningful participation in everyday life. 

 They support children, adults, older individuals, NDIS participants, and clients requiring outpatient rehabilitation services. The team values innovation, evidence-based practice, and personalised care, with a strong focus on achieving real-world outcomes for every client.

 An exciting opportunity is available for a Speech Pathologist to join the team on a contractor basis. This role offers flexibility and autonomy while being supported within a collaborative Allied Health environment. 

 The successful clinician will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of communication and swallowing disorders while delivering tailored, goal-oriented therapy programs aligned with each client’s individual strengths, interests, and goals. 

 You will work closely with Occupational Therapists, Physiotherapists, Psychologists, and other allied health professionals to provide integrated and meaningful care. 

Key Responsibilities

 
	 Conduct assessments for speech, language, communication, AAC, and swallowing difficulties 
	 Develop evidence-based and individualised therapy plans 
	 Deliver interventions targeting articulation, language, social communication, cognitive-communication, and dysphagia management 
	 Utilise AAC systems, technology-based supports, and creative therapy approaches 
	 Collaborate within a multidisciplinary Allied Health team to support coordinated client outcomes 
	 Empower clients to improve independence, confidence, and participation within their families, workplaces, and communities

	 Opportunity to work with a varied and meaningful caseload 
	 Access to collaborative Allied Health support and professional development opportunities 
	 Autonomy to manage your schedule and caseload 
	 Innovative workplace utilising AAC and technology-driven therapy approaches 
 

   

  Requirements:  

 
	 Tertiary qualification in Speech Pathology
